cost_v1_h20261004_pm_midterm.stress: all costs doubled (4 bp and 20 bp per side)
cost_v1_h20261004_pm_midterm.unit: per side per unit change in an asset's position (position in [-1, 1] times direction, one unit = full weight of that asset)
cost_v1_h20261004_pm_midterm.fill_rule: Signal from the 4pm-to-4pm probability change of session t-1 (lagged one session); position held over the close-to-close return of session t, executed MOC at the close of t-1. No limit orders, no price improvement.
cost_v1_h20261004_pm_midterm.borrow_note: Negative positions are modelled as shorts of easy-to-borrow ETFs and large banks with no borrow charge in the primary series (the signal flips sign often and every leg is a liquid ETF or large cap); DJT and PHUN shorts are not realistic as hard-to-borrow names and are costed at 10 bp per side only. This is reported as a caveat in report.md.
cost_v1_h20261004_pm_midterm.note: Costs as frozen in hypotheses.md; TSLA is not named there and takes the 2 bp large-cap rate (ruling recorded in data-feasibility.json).
